title: Honesty is the Best Policy ... or is it? Demand Management for Probabilistic Service Options
abstract: arXiv:2610.21351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To enable well-informed customer choices and redistribute demand across service options, providers can display probabilities regarding predicted service levels at the time of booking, effectively offering probabilistic service options. In many service settings, the underlying truthful probabilities endogenously depend on the system state, rather than being static product attributes controlled by the provider. While customers rely on this information when making decisions, they cannot readily verify its accuracy. Consequently, providers may be tempted to manipulate the displayed probabilities to guide customers' choices in their favor, creating a novel lever for demand management. In this work, we model the resulting problem as a sequential decision process, define truthful probabilities recursively, and introduce transparency constraints that limit their distortion. translated_title: 诚实是最好的策略……果真如此吗？概率性服务选项的需求管理
translated_abstract: 为了让客户做出充分知情的选择，并在各服务选项之间重新分配需求，服务提供商可以在预订时展示关于预测服务水平的概率，从而实际上提供“概率性服务选项”。在许多服务场景中，潜在的真实概率内生地依赖于系统状态，而非由提供商控制的静态产品属性。虽然客户在决策时依赖这些信息，却难以验证其准确性。因此，提供商可能会试图操纵所展示的概率，以引导客户做出有利于自身的选择，这为需求管理提供了一种新颖的杠杆。在本工作中，我们将由此产生的问题建模为一个序列决策过程，递归地定义真实概率，并引入限制其失真程度的透明度约束。由于真实概率的精确计算是难以求解的……
tldr: 该论文将概率性服务选项下的需求管理建模为序列决策过程，通过递归定义真实概率并引入透明度约束，首次系统研究了提供商操纵展示概率这一新型需求管理杠杆及其与诚实披露之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper models demand management for probabilistic service options as a sequential decision process, recursively defining truthful probabilities and introducing transparency constraints to study the manipulation of displayed probabilities as a novel demand management lever and its trade-off with honesty.
